entries.subject: Ďurech & Hanuš (2026), model 1 of (9969) Braille: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: Model 1 of the deposit (version 2026-09-17), pole (315.8°, -15.7°), period 227.854386 h, taken unchanged from shape_models/model_9969_1.tri. The deposit lists two spin solutions with the same period. Solution 1 is selected because its mesh has the proportions Deep Space 1 and ground-based photometry gave (2.1 × 1 × 1 km, Oberst et al. 2001); the proportions of both meshes are in /comparison. No unique-pole claim.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 1.19 ± 0.04 km, volume-equivalent diameter of this mesh with its three extents fitted to the published 2.1 × 1 × 1 km. The mesh's longest extent across the spin axis, the extent at right angles to it and the extent along the spin axis are 2.1533, 1.1070, 1.0620 source units. One scale fitted to 2.1, 1, 1 km by least squares is 0.9572 km per unit; each extent alone gives 0.975, 0.903, 0.942 km per unit, and half that range is the quoted uncertainty. The published dimensions carry no error bars.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The two DS1 frames and integrated spectra do not provide a registered global surface mosaic for the selected approximation. The existing grid marks unmapped terrain; integrated spectra are not surface maps.
entries.revisitWhen: A reusable observation or mapped product supplies pixel geometry and registration to a source model that can be compared with the selected ellipsoid.

entries.subject: NASA Deep Space 1 mission page
entries.finding: The NASA mission page provides mission context only. It is not a body shape, image, geometry, or map product and supplies no scientific input to this package.
entries.revisitWhen: The mission page publishes or links a versioned Braille product with enough native metadata to assess it as a source candidate.

entries.subject: PIA01345 enhanced DS1 composite
entries.finding: PIA01345 is a public composite of the two MICAS frames, made after interpolation of neighbouring pixels to reduce spatial-frequency artefacts. Its caption establishes that it is a derivative display image, not a native calibrated observation or registration product; it is unsuitable as a source texture or shape constraint.
entries.revisitWhen: The corresponding native MICAS observations, labels, calibration and geometry are available for a model-registration assessment.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "227.854386 hours" (doi-10-5281-zenodo-22812438) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 6470 period 226.4 h (U 2, synodic); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
